propositions: Cold-cache Pass-1 execution submits all chunks and agent futures simultaneously to a 6-wide pool, causing redundant cache-WRITE operations for the shared system prefix across multiple concurrent calls (~7.9N effective tokens vs 2.15N ideal, 3.7x overhead)

Warm-then-fan-out pattern proven for container bins can be ported to the main pool: when shared-prefix tokens >= CACHE_MIN_PREFIX_TOKENS and Pass-1 calls >= 2, run the first chunk serially to write the cache prefix, then submit remainder to the pool
Non-systemic warm-call failures degrade to direct fan-out of remaining chunks without aborting the review, matching container path behavior
With warm-then-fan-out enabled, the shared prefix incurs exactly one cache-WRITE from the warm call and N-1 cache-READs from fanned-out calls
